'''Holo-Sec Corp''' was a company that produced and patented an explosive device used in conjunction with a holographic security system. This particular explosive device was the [[Holo-Sec Corp anti-theft explosive]].

In [[3956 BBY]], a friend of [[Gilthos Uksaris]], band manager of [[the Twisted Rancor Trio]], delivered a package of 50 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] and a suit of [[Echani fiber armor]] to him at an [[Lower City Apartments|apartment]] in the [[Lower City]] of [[Taris/Legends|Taris]]. He sought to secure this package from theft using the security system manufactured by this company.
